cases.assertion: A participant sends an owned private upload, optionally without body text, and quotes a live message in the same conversation.
A foreign, reused, public or incorrectly scoped upload cannot be attached or downloaded through the direct conversation.
A reply reference to another conversation is rejected, with no partial message.
A participant can add/remove an own reaction idempotently. Private update delivery allows live viewer-specific receipt refresh without changing read pointers.
Only current participants may download an attached object, and deletion hides it.
